why_post_result: The smoke summaries showed that three correct anchors and the same three anchors each contaminated by +0.25 produced identical fit-flag transitions while WLE bias moved by approximately +0.25. This diagnostic was formulated after that inspection and cannot be treated as a prospectively specified smoke result.

mathematical_hypothesis.statement: Adding a common delta to every fixed and free expanded Rater effect subtracts delta times category from each response-unit log kernel. Conditional on a Person raw total, the resulting minus-delta-times-total term is constant across response patterns and cancels from the exact conditional likelihood.
mathematical_hypothesis.person_scoring_implication: Adding delta to every Rater difficulty and delta to the Person measure preserves all category probabilities because the structural kernel changes by minus-delta-times-category while the Person term changes by plus-delta-times-category.
mathematical_hypothesis.fit_implication: Expected scores, residuals, Infit, Outfit, and raw-value fit decisions cannot detect a pure common-mode anchor-origin shift.
mathematical_hypothesis.scope_boundary: This invariance does not apply to differential anchor contamination, where anchor errors vary by level.
